payload.prompt:
Puri ka thelaA1. Programs & Responsibilities
1) Escrow Manager (vault + lifecycle)
State
projects: Map<ProjectId, Project>
proposals: Map<ProjectId, Vec<Proposal>>
milestones: Map<ProjectId, Vec<Milestone>>
authorized_verifier: ActorId (Verification Bridge)
platform_treasury: ActorId
fee_bps: u16 (default 500 = 5%)
Core Types
Project { owner, selected_dev?, budget, currency, status, progress_pool, final_pool, released_progress, released_final }
Proposal { dev, quote, milestone_specs, metadata }
Milestone { idx, name, weight_bps, target_tests?, status, percent_complete_bps, ipfs_cids[] }
Actions
CreateProject{budget, currency, meta} (payer attaches funds) → fee skim to treasury; split: progress_pool = 60%, final_pool = 35%.
SubmitProposal{project_id, quote, milestones, meta}
SelectDeveloper{project_id, dev, accepted_quote}
UpdateMilestone{project_id, idx, meta?} (owner/admin)
MarkFinalApproved{project_id} (owner wallet)
CancelProject{project_id} (rules: only pre-selection or by dispute outcome)
Verifier-only:
ApplyProgress{project_id, idx, new_percent_bps, ipfs_cid}
Computes delta, accrues releasable from progress_pool, and pays developer instantly up to pool remaining.
Queries
GetProject, GetMilestones, GetProposalList, GetAccounting
Events
ProposalSubmitted, DeveloperSelected, ProgressApplied, ProgressPaid, FinalApproved, Disputed, Refunded
Guards
Only authorized_verifier may call ApplyProgress.
Final approval must be signed by owner to release final_pool (35%).
2) Verification Bridge (attestations + policy)
State
admin
escrow_manager: ActorId
bindings: Map<RepoOrArtifact, (project_id, milestone_idx)>
records: Map<(project_id, idx), Vec<Attestation>> (bounded, e.g., 25)
policy_cfg { min_step_bps, smoothing_alpha_bps, test_required: bool }
Action
Bind{ repo|artifact, project_id, idx }
SubmitAttestation{ attestation } (whitelisted relayer only)
→ Validates signature + repo binding, computes % completion (EMA optional), emits ApplyProgress to Escrow Manager with:
{ project_id, idx, new_percent_bps, ipfs_cid_summary }
Notes
Keeps monotonic percent per milestone (never decreases).
Requires/records evidence CIDs (commit diff report, test runs, coverage, SBOM, etc).
If test_required=true, caps percent until passing tests present.
